name: Conveyor System
purpose: Moves products and materials between different stages of a production process.
commonProblem: Belt misalignment, excessive wear, unusual noise, or motor problems.
maintenance: Inspect belt alignment, rollers, bearings, guards, and drive components.

name: Centrifugal Pump
purpose: Moves liquids through pipes and process systems.
commonProblem: Low flow, leakage, vibration, cavitation, or unusual noise.
maintenance: Inspect seals, bearings, coupling, lubrication, and pump alignment.

name: Air Compressor
purpose: Provides compressed air for pneumatic equipment and production processes.
commonProblem: Low pressure, overheating, air leaks, or excessive noise.
maintenance: Check filters, oil level, cooling system, hoses, and air leaks.

name: Electric Motor
purpose: Converts electrical energy into mechanical motion.
commonProblem: Overheating, vibration, unusual noise, or failure to start.
maintenance: Inspect connections, bearings, cooling, alignment, and operating temperature.

name: Packaging Machine
purpose: Packages products using automated filling, sealing, wrapping, or labeling processes.
commonProblem: Poor sealing, incorrect positioning, film problems, or sensor faults.
maintenance: Inspect sensors, sealing components, belts, film paths, and moving parts.

name: Industrial Mixer
purpose: Mixes ingredients or materials to produce a consistent product.
commonProblem: Uneven mixing, unusual vibration, motor overload, or blade wear.
maintenance: Inspect blades, bearings, motor, shaft, seals, and mixer guards.

name: Gearbox
purpose: Transfers mechanical power while changing speed and torque.
commonProblem: Noise, overheating, vibration, oil leakage, or gear wear.
maintenance: Check oil level, seals, gears, bearings, alignment, and mounting.

name: Control Panel
purpose: Controls electrical and automated functions of industrial equipment.
commonProblem: Tripped breakers, loose connections, alarms, or control failures.
maintenance: Inspect connections, components, ventilation, indicators, and control wiring.

name: Industrial Fan
purpose: Moves air for ventilation, cooling, or industrial process requirements.
commonProblem: Vibration, unusual noise, low airflow, or motor overheating.
maintenance: Inspect blades, bearings, motor, guards, mounting, and airflow.

name: Filling Machine
purpose: Fills containers with a controlled amount of liquid or product.
commonProblem: Incorrect fill volume, leakage, blocked nozzles, or sensor problems.
maintenance: Inspect nozzles, sensors, valves, seals, product lines, and controls.

name: Boiler
purpose: Generates steam or hot water for industrial processes.
commonProblem: Low pressure, leaks, overheating, poor combustion, or scale buildup.
maintenance: Follow approved boiler procedures and inspect controls, water systems, and safety devices.

name: Hydraulic Press
purpose: Uses hydraulic pressure to apply force during manufacturing operations.
commonProblem: Low pressure, hydraulic leaks, slow operation, or cylinder problems.
maintenance: Inspect hydraulic fluid, hoses, seals, cylinders, filters, and pressure systems.

name: PLC System
purpose: Controls automated industrial processes using programmed logic.
commonProblem: Communication errors, input/output faults, alarms, or program-related problems.
maintenance: Inspect connections, cooling, indicators, backups, and fault messages.

name: Vacuum Pump
purpose: Creates a vacuum for industrial processing and packaging applications.
commonProblem: Poor vacuum, oil problems, leakage, overheating, or unusual noise.
maintenance: Check oil, filters, seals, hoses, cooling, and operating condition.

name: Industrial Dryer
purpose: Removes moisture from materials or products during industrial processing.
commonProblem: Poor drying, overheating, airflow problems, or temperature control faults.
maintenance: Inspect heating components, airflow, filters, fans, sensors, and controls.
